entities.summary: Clinton Wheeler was an American professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-1-inch (185 cm) 185 pounds (84 kg) point guard and played collegiately at Division III's William Paterson University. In his brief NBA career from 1987 to 1989, he played for three teams.
